messages:
Sam: Quick release note — we're cutting the RC at 10:00 PDT tomorrow. Need final docs + SDK regen gated on the changelog bump and console microcopy. @Maya @Lina can you confirm the staging deploy and the SDK-docs regen sequence?

Maya: On it. Plan: 1) merge changelog bump, 2) run `yarn docs:build --staging`, 3) kick the deploy job. I'll post build id and preview when done.

Lina: I'll wait for staging to be healthy, then run the SDK docs regen. CC @Jen for the changelog PR.

Jen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — changelog entry + version bump to 1.14.0. Left a tiny nit on line 23 about wording.

Ashwin: Reviewing now. Quick question — any runtime API surface changes that need console copy tweaks?

Jen: No runtime API changes. Just packaging/pack version wording in the changelog. Console only needs the version badge bumped.

Maya: Merge is green. Merged PR 482. Starting staging build now. Build id: build-7932

deploy-bot: staging build build-7932 succeeded in 4m 12s. Preview URL: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/rc-1.14.0

Lina: Running SDK docs regen: `./scripts/regen_sdk_docs.sh --target staging` — starting now.

Lina: Regen completed, pushed branch docs/sdk-regen-1.14.0 -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-docs/pull/79

Bobby: Quick QA pass on staging preview done. Found one broken link in "Console > Rollouts" — filed issue #321.

Maya: Fixed the link in staging and redeployed. New preview (same url): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/rc-1.14.0

Sam: Awesome. Two quick asks before the RC cut: (1) Jen, add that tiny note about the SDK fixture change to the changelog (line 23). (2) Ashwin, can you approve and merge the SDK-docs PR so we can sync the console copy?

Ashwin: Merged SDK docs PR #79. :thumbsup:

Sam: OK locking in cutoff. I'll tag the release branch at 10:00 PDT tomorrow. If anyone sees regressions or weirdness, ping me here. Thanks all.

Maya: :rocket:
